title: Extension over the fixed field is separable and normal
statement: Let $F$ and $E$ be fields and let $E/F$ be an algebraic normal extension [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-algebraic-element]. Put $S=\{x\in E: \sigma(x)=x\text{ for every }F\text{-algebra automorphism }\sigma\text{ of }E\}$. Then $E/S$ is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] and normal.

source.place: Fields, Lemma Tag 030M (lemma-normal-case, line 3666), part (2), with $E_{insep}=E^{\mathrm{Aut}(E/F)}$ as in its proof ('Details omitted'); tag verified in literature/stacks-project/tags/tags (030M,fields-lemma-normal-case)

proof.text: Let t be the finite set of distinct E-roots of minpoly F a. The polynomial is nonzero by algebraicity, and a belongs to t. Each F-automorphism sigma preserves t: Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply maps the vanishing equation to itself. Its inverse proves surjectivity on t. No transitivity or conjugacy theorem is needed.

IntermediateField.normal supplies Normal S E from Normal F E for the fixed intermediate field S (the instance uses Normal.tower_top_of_normal [lem-weil-pbc-normal-extension-normal-over-intermediate]).

Form q=product over y in t of (X-C y). Finset.prod_bij for sigma gives q.map sigma=q, so every coefficient is in S. Construct Q in S[X] with Polynomial.toSubring and identify Q.map (algebraMap S E)=q using map_toSubring. Since a is a root, minpoly S a divides Q by minpoly.dvd. Distinct factors give separability of q, separable_map descends it to Q, and Separable.of_dvd gives separability of minpoly S a [lem-weil-pbc-distinct-linear-factors-separable]. This proves Algebra.IsSeparable S E; normality is supplied by the preceding instance. Q is an explicit coefficient construction, with no existential witness choice.

lean.statement:
theorem fixedField_separable_normal
    (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [Field F] [Field E] [Algebra F E] [Normal F E] :
    Algebra.IsSeparable (IntermediateField.fixedField (⊤ : Subgroup (E ≃ₐ[F] E))) E ∧
      Normal (IntermediateField.fixedField (⊤ : Subgroup (E ≃ₐ[F] E))) E
